heading: Authorization of appropriations

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out the functions and responsibilities of the Secretary under this subchapter and the Agreement $1,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2010.

tree.heading: Commission
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out functions and responsibilities of the United States Section 1 $150,000 for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2010.

tree.heading: Alaskan cooperative management program
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this subchapter and the Agreement in Alaska $150,000 for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2010.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 92–522, title V, § 509, as added Pub. L. 109–479, title IX, § 902(a), Jan. 12, 2007, 120 Stat. 3665.)
